title: Prevalence of Odontogenic Neoplasms in Educational Hospitals and Institutions in Cairo
author: Leena Ali
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.t6ceraw
materials: 3 6b. PECO Patients: Patients reports with odontogenic neoplasms in Cairo 's educational hospitals and institutions. Exposure: Odontogenic neoplasms diagnosed based on histopathological examinations. Control: Not applicable. Outcome: Prevalence rate. Outcome name Measuring unit Primary outcome Prevalence rate of odontogenic neoplasms. Number of odontogenic neoplasms cases Total no. of all cases Secondary outcome Prevalence of odontogenic neoplasms in relation to:  Age (all ages)  Gender (male &female).  Site affection. --- Research Question:  What is the prevalence of odontogenic neoplasms in educational hospitals and institutions in Cairo? Objective  The objective of this study is to determine the prevalence of odontogenic neoplams diagnosed histopathologically over a period of 5 years (from 2014 to 2018) in Cairo's educational hospitals and institutions. Furthermore, stratification of age, gender and site affection of each individual lesion will be performed.

steps.title: 4 III. Methods
steps.instruction: 4 III. Methods: 7. Study design Retrospective cross-sectional study. 8. Settings 1. In Cairo city. 2. The date of data collection of odontogenic tumors reports (from 2014 to 2018). 3. The data will be collected from archive of all Cairo's educational hospitals and institutions. A) Participants 9. Eligibility criteria and selection methods Patient adhering to all following criteria will be included: Inclusion criteria:  Age: all age groups.  Gender: both genders.  Site: maxilla and mandible.  All odontogenic neoplasms that fit the histological classification of the World Health Organization (2017) will be included in the study.  All reports should include in period between (2014 and 2018). Exclusion criteria:  Any patient's report that doesn't record in archive of educational hospitals and institutions in Cairo.  Any reports not found in period between (2014 and 2018).  Non-odontogenic lesions. 10. Matching criteria and allocation ratio Not applicable.

Number of odontogenic neoplasms cases Total no. of all cases Secondary outcome Prevalence of odontogenic neoplasms in relation to:  Age (all ages)  Gender (male &female).  Site affection. --- 12. Data sources and management The data will be collect ed from all Cairo's educational hospitals and institutions in a period between (2014 and 2018). This data will analysis according to age, gender and site affection with the different types of odontogenic tumor according to the histological classification of the World Health Organization (2017) (Soluk-Tekkeşin and Wright, 2017). 13. Addressing potential sources of bias  Improper diagnostic methods.  Poor investigations for some difficult cases.

steps.title: 6 D) Study size 14
steps.instruction: 6 D) Study size 14. Study size No sample size could be applied on our epidemiological study. E) Statistical methods 15. Statistical methods Categorical variables will be expressed in proportions or percentages; Chi square and Fisher’s exact tests will be applied as appropriate. Continuous variables will be examined for normality using Kolmogrov-Smirnov test and Shapiro-Wilk test. They will be expressed using range, mean, median± standard deviation (normal variables); range, median and interquartile range (non -normal variables). Test of significance will be used for comparison/association. The results were considered statistically significant for a value of p≤0.05.
